articles.title: Vivenne Jolie files to officially drop "Pitt" from last name
articles.description: https://instagram.com/p/DbEwoCPFmLP In news we all suspected was coming Vivienne Jolie, daughter of Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt, filed to legally drop Pitt from her last name Vivienne had previously been using only the Jolie surname professionally so this isn't exactly a surprise Out of the 6 Jolie-Pitt children, only two currently have that surname (Knox and Pax) Shiloh was the first to legally file to drop the name in 2024 on her 18th birthday. Maddox and Zaharah both recently filed and their cases will be heard in September. Vivienne's case will be heard in November Name changing is a multi-layered process which means that the children will have to have the name change approved by a judge though this seems completely likely to go forward Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt's children appear to have a tense/non-existant relationship with their father ever since he was believed to attack Jolie and one of the children on an airplane in 2016 Neither Angelina nor Brad have commented source Continue to hope Angelina and the kids live their best lives.
